newsitem.title: USA: Metal Management says to buy FPX, Southern Tin.
newsitem.headline: Metal Management says to buy FPX, Southern Tin.

text.p: Metal Management Inc FPX Inc said Wednesday it will buy FPX Inc and Southern Tin Compress Corp.

Under the mergers, FPX and Southern Tin shareholders will receive an aggregate purchase price of 789.740 shares of Metal Management common stock. Also at closing, an affiliate of FPX shareholders will be repaid $2.0 million owed it from PerlCo.

FPX owns half of PerlCo LLC, a limited liability company in Tennessee that supplies ferrous metal to minimills on the Mississippi River and Gulf coast. Chicago-based Metal Management said it will acquire the other half of PerlCo when it closes its pending merger with Cozzi Iron & Metal Inc, a Chicago scrap metal recycler.
Southern Tin, based in Memphis, Tennessee, owns the real estate and certain equipment of the PerlCo operations.
Metal Management is a consolidator of the scrap metal recycling industry. MTLM.O shares traded at 22-3/4, up 5/16.
